title: XYZ FORGE SOFTWARE FACTORY: THE SKILLS THAT TURN ISSUES INTO MERGED WORK
subtitle: Seven operator commands carry work from a daily read of what matters to reviewed, merged and reconciled changes. Method skills and durable records sit underneath.

daily.label: Orient
daily.caption: Every 15 minutes, fuses prompts, next actions, calendar and git state into a daily log with coaching.

intake.label: Intake front doors
intake.caption: /idea files an operator idea. /triage files an outside report.

workhorse.label: Diagnose & design
workhorse.caption: Ground truth, leanest safe fix and a cross-model stress test, for tangled or ambiguous problems.

startTask.label: Build one task to a ready PR
startTask.caption: Fresh clone, recon, plan, Codex plan QA, build, gates, final QA.

review.label: Review against ground truth
review.caption: Recon and debug-mantra on the diff or PR; fixes reversible issues.

merge.label: Land & reconcile
merge.caption: Merges PRs in dependency order, reconciles PDDA and the ledger, retires clones.

github.label: GitHub
github.caption: Issues, pull requests and hosted CI.

ate.label: Automated testing
ate.caption: Unattended variation and fuzz runs: pairwise grids, mutational fuzzing, parity oracles. Files one ranked issue per run.

edges.mergeRec: reconciles ledger and PDDA; retires clones

entries.label: Roadmap & release ledger
entries.caption: releases.db: backlog, ratings, waves, shipped work.

entries.label: PDDA project documents
entries.caption: Capture docs, plans, status, handoff context.

footer.note: Schematic: shows how the skills hand work to each other, not timing or every flag. /marathon stands for /start-marathon plus /pre-marathon. Icons are hand-drawn vectors; no images were generated.
footer.source: Skill roles summarized from their SKILL.md descriptions in HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge (skills/, utils/ate/, GH-299 engines) and the deployed /daily skill. Version 2 of the October 14 XYZ Forge system example.
